# The Tasks block: a process under a terminal is marked with it, its
# details read, and Quit ends it (only this probe's own `sleep 307.25`).
size:1280x800
wait:0.5
type:sleep 307.25
key:enter
wait:0.6
key:cmd+shift+p
wait:0.4
type:tasks
wait:0.3
expect-palette:Tasks
key:enter
wait:1.0
page-wait:go
expect-tab:Tasks
wait:1.0
page-click:In Terminals
wait:0.3
page-type:.search=sleep
wait:0.3
expect-page:sleep
expect-page:▸
page-click:css:tbody tr[data-name="sleep"]
wait:0.8
expect-page:Command
expect-page:sleep 307.25
expect-page:Show Terminal
shot:tasks.png
page-click:Quit
wait:0.4
expect-page:Quit sleep?
page-click:css:.dialog .button.primary
wait:1.0
expect-shell:ps -axo command= | grep -qx 'sleep 307.25' && echo alive || echo gone ==> gone
expect-page:Asked sleep to quit
